ja159:1.1: Udet' ayaṃ cakkhumā ekarājā harissavaṇṇo paṭhavippabhāso; taṃ taṃ namassāmi harissavaṇṇaṃ paṭhavippabhāsaṃ, tay' ajja guttā viharemu divasan ti.
ja159:2.1: Ye brāhmaṇā vedagū sabbadhamme te me namo te ca maṃ pālayantu; nam' atthu Buddhānaṃ, nam' atthu bodhiyā, namo vimuttānaṃ, namo vimuttiyā. Apet' ayaṃ cakkhumā ekarājā harissavaṇṇo
ja159:3.1: paṭhavippabhāso; taṃ taṃ namassāmi harissavaṇṇaṃ paṭhavippabhāsaṃ, tay' ajja guttā viharemu rattiṃ.
ja159:4.1: Ye brāhmaṇā vedagū sabbadhamme te me nāmo te ca maṃ pālayantu; nam' atthu buddhānaṃ, nam' atthu bodhiyā, namo vimuttānaṃ, namo vimuttiyā. Evam eva nūna rājānaṃ Vedehaṃ Mithilaggahaṃ
